sites.source: No Town of Del Norte page says anything about RV spots (site search and the municipal code's parks article, read 2026-10-27). The 35-ft figure was derived from note prose that rests only on directory listings (The Dyrt / RV Life), so it is cleared.

facilities.source: Same as sites: the town's pages do not mention a dump station or water fill; the derived values rest only on directory listings (Campendium/The Dyrt), so they are cleared.

booking.source: Same as sites: no town page states a booking rule or a one-night limit; the derived values rest only on directory listings. The municipal code (Sec. 11-4-110) only lets vehicles and 'self-contained mobile unit[s]' park in parks 'in designated areas, at designated times and for purposes as designated by the Town Clerk/Administrator', and parks close 11 p.m.-5 a.m. (Sec. 11-4-60). Read 2026-10-27.

fees.source: Same as sites: 'free' rests only on directory listings; no town page or fee schedule (https://www.delnortecolorado.com/town-of-del-norte-fee-schedule/) mentions overnight RV parking. Read 2026-10-27.

note: Town of Del Norte's North Park (1st & Spruce, across from Town Hall), beside the Rio Grande. Directory listings (not the town) describe a few free one-night spots for self-contained RVs with a free dump station and water fill, and camper reviews say a sign asks for permission from the town office; the town publishes nothing about overnight RV parking. --Claude
summary: The Town of Del Norte publishes nothing about RV camping: no page on its website (site search for camping/RV/park/dump finds none; the fee schedule lists none), and its municipal code closes parks 11 p.m.-5 a.m. and allows vehicles or self-contained units only in areas/times the Town Clerk designates. Every stored derived value (35-ft max, dump, water, FCFS, 1-night max, $0) rests only on directory listings, so all are cleared. Pin sits in North Park, ~40-150 m from the Rio Grande behind a tree line. Town Hall phone 719-657-2708.
flags: CRITERIA: the town does not designate RV camping spots on any page it publishes. Municipal code Ch. 11 Art. 4: 'The parks shall be open daily to the public from 5:00 a.m. until 11:00 p.m., and no person ... shall remain in them at any other time; provided, however, that the Town Clerk/Administrator may, by permit first having been obtained, extend or limit the time' (Sec. 11-4-60) and 'No motor vehicle ... or self-contained mobile unit shall park on such parks ... except in designated areas, at designated times and for purposes as designated by the Town Clerk/Administrator' (Sec. 11-4-110). The overnight allowance is known only from directory listings and camper reviews (Campendium: a sign asks for permission from the town office across the street). This looks like a by-permission parking allowance, not designated camping spots; candidate drop under the curation doc (a parking-lot allowance does not qualify).
Missing operator page: delnortecolorado.com (the stored website) has no page about the park's RV spots; there is no better town URL to give.
Missing phone: Town Hall 719-657-2708 (https://www.delnortecolorado.com/ header and footer).

Waterfront re-audit lead: stored riverfront. On Esri imagery the pin is in North Park, a mown lawn south of the Rio Grande; the river runs past its north edge behind a tree/willow strip about 40 m from the lawn, and the gravel parking along the park's west and south edges sits ~60-150 m from the water with the trees between. Where the RV spots are is not published, so open-apron riverfront cannot be confirmed; riverview or not waterfront looks likelier.
